checks.name: sealed_lineage_exposes_divergence_and_locked_recovery
checks.run:
import json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from factoryline.graph_forensics import graph_forensics, seal_graph_lineage
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
    root = Path(raw)
    base = [{"sequence":1,"superstep":0,"node_id":"worker","checkpoint_id":"cp-1","reads":[],"writes":[],"evidence":[],"side_effects":[],"decision":{"route":"finish","reason":"verified"}}]
    candidate = [{**base[0], "decision":{"route":"repair","reason":"failed verification"}}]
    left_steps, right_steps = root / "left-steps.json", root / "right-steps.json"
    left_steps.write_text(json.dumps(base), encoding="utf-8")
    right_steps.write_text(json.dumps(candidate), encoding="utf-8")
    left, right = root / "left.json", root / "right.json"
    seal_graph_lineage("left", "graph", left_steps, left)
    seal_graph_lineage("right", "graph", right_steps, right)
    result = graph_forensics(left, right)
    assert result["marker"] == "GRAPH_FORENSICS_VERIFIED_SEMANTIC_TIME_TRAVEL"
    assert result["divergence"]["sequence"] == 1
    assert result["recovery_plan"]["execute"] is False
    assert result["authority"]["checkpoint_mutation"] is False
print("GRAPH_FORENSICS_SMOKE_PASS")
